# Better Pets and Gardens

> > Your comprehensive resource for pet care, garden supplies, and pool maintenance across Western Australia.

Better Pets and Gardens is a Perth-based retailer offering expert guidance on pet care (dogs, cats, fish), gardening, and pool/spa maintenance. The site features multiple store locations across Western Australia, community adoption events, and a loyalty program for customers.

## Key Topics

- Pet Care
- Dog Training
- Puppy Training
- Cat Care
- Garden Supplies
- Pool Maintenance
- Water Testing
- Pet Supplies
- Store Locations
- Western Australia
- Customer Support
- Loyalty Program
- Pet Adoption
- Pet Travel
- Aquariums & Ponds

## Pet Care Guides

- [Pet Care Hub](https://www.betterpetsandgardens.com.au/pet-care): Main pet care hub covering dogs, cats, puppies and pet advice
- [Dogs & Puppies](https://www.betterpetsandgardens.com.au/pet-care/dogs): Dog and puppy care guides, training, behavior and socialization tips
- [Cats & Kittens](https://www.betterpetsandgardens.com.au/pet-care/cats): Cat and kitten care guides covering health, grooming, diet and behavior
- [Fish, Aquariums & Ponds](https://www.betterpetsandgardens.com.au/fish): Fish care, aquarium and pond guides for freshwater and pond species
- [Holidays with Pets](https://www.betterpetsandgardens.com.au/pet-care/dogs/holidays-and-travel/holidays-with-pets): Pet travel guide covering accommodation, packing and holiday preparation

## Garden & Outdoor Supplies

- [Garden Care Hub](https://www.betterpetsandgardens.com.au/gardens): Main garden care hub with vegetable growing, herbs and maintenance guides
- [Pools & Spas](https://www.betterpetsandgardens.com.au/pools-and-spas): Pool and spa maintenance, water testing and seasonal care advice
